<b>Crests</b> are a special type of collectible in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i> that allow [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] to use different [[Needle]] attacks and equip different [[Tools]].

== Crests ==
Crests alters Hornet's attacks with the [[Needle]], as well as giving her a new unique ability. Each Crest changes the design of the HUD around the wheel in the upper left to indicate which Crest is equipped, and some designs change further to indicate when the Crest's mechanic is active.

[[Tools]] and [[Skills]] are equipped in slots on Crests. Each Crest starts with a varying number of {{CrestSlot|Red|1}}, {{CrestSlot|Yellow|1}}, {{CrestSlot|Blue|1}}, and {{CrestSlot|Skill|1}} slots unlocked. Some Tool slots on each Crest must be unlocked with [[Memory Locket]]s.

=== Vesticrest ===
The <b>Vesticrest</b> adds additional tool slots that operate independently from Crests. [[Tools]] equipped to the Vesticrest will remain equipped regardless of which Crest is equipped. 

The Vesticrest is given by [[Eva]] in [[Weavenest Atla]] once 12 slots have been unlocked across all Crests except for the [[Hunter Crest]]. Any slots that are automatically unlocked when the Crest is claimed add to the total number of unlocked slots. It allows for one {{CrestSlot|Yellow|1}} to be equipped.

After 20 slots have been unlocked, Eva will upgrade the Vesticrest to also allow one {{CrestSlot|Blue|1}} to be equipped.

==Creation and Development==
Crests were first shown off in the February 2019 <i>Silksong</i> reveal trailer.<ref name="trailer">[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=pFAknD_9U7c Hollow Knight: Silksong Reveal Trailer]</ref> A crest internally named the [[Cut Content (Silksong)/Items#Crests|Weaver Crest]] was planned, but removed, with its function unknown; a sprite of it can be seen in the reveal trailer and some others remain the files.<ref name="trailer" /> An early development method for upgrading Crests would have used an "experience" system where interacting with each Crest's unique function would slowly level up that specific crest and unlock its slots in place of [[Memory Locket]]s. According to [[William Pellen]], this mechanic was cut as it was difficult to explain using the UI and allowed for players to grind to unlock every slot right away.<ref name="bloomberg2">[https://www.bloomberg.com/news/newsletters/2025-11-28/the-makers-of-hollow-knight-silksong-aren-t-done-just-yet The Makers of 'Silksong' Aren't Done Just Yet] on Bloomberg</ref>
